LanguageData.Gun_Thompson_UMP45_RWP.description: The UMP45 is a compact and reliable submachine gun known for its high stopping power and moderate range. It fires .45 ACP rounds, making it effective in close-quarters combat where accuracy and velocity can dictate survival. Its lightweight design ensures quick maneuverability, ideal for tactical assaults and defensive scenarios.
